ground_truth_eval_only.description: Upstream O2 sensor (Bank 1 Sensor 1) has failed, stuck railed lean at ~0.04V with no switching. The actual engine mixture is correct, but the ECU sees 'lean' and adds fuel via closed-loop trim correction. Trims climb gradually as ECU integrates the false lean signal. Engine runs slightly rich due to the ECU's over-compensation, but no significant driveability issues.
ground_truth_eval_only.root_cause: O2 sensor failure — upstream sensor (B1S1) stuck railed lean

discriminators.o2_sensor_fault: O2 voltage flatlined near 0V with NO switching pattern; fuel trims climb gradually (ECU integrating false lean signal); MAF reads correctly and tracks RPM/load smoothly.
discriminators.vacuum_leak: MAF reads low with consistent offset; trims rise with load immediately, not gradually over time.
discriminators.maf_fault: MAF readings erratic; trims proportional to MAF error, not a slow integration.
discriminators.weak_fuel_delivery: Trims go NEGATIVE at high load; fuel pressure drops under demand.
discriminators.ignition_fault: Misfires on specific cylinders; trims near normal.

notes: Ground truth for evaluation only; never exposed through MCP tools.
